templates.name: AI Addendum
templates.description: Common Paper standard addendum covering the use of AI features and services, including training on customer data and treatment of AI inputs and outputs.

templates.name: Business Associate Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard Business Associate Agreement (BAA) governing the handling of protected health information under HIPAA.

templates.name: Cloud Service Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard Cloud Service Agreement (CSA) standard terms for selling and buying SaaS and other cloud services.

templates.name: Design Partner Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard Design Partner Agreement for early-stage collaborations where a customer gets early product access in exchange for feedback.

templates.name: Data Processing Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper Data Processing Agreement (DPA) setting out how a provider processes personal data on behalf of a customer, including GDPR terms.

templates.name: Mutual NDA Cover Page
templates.description: Cover page for the Common Paper Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement, where the parties fill in purpose, effective date, term and other deal-specific details.

templates.name: Mutual NDA Standard Terms
templates.description: Common Paper Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement standard terms governing how both parties protect each other's confidential information.

templates.name: Partnership Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard Partnership Agreement for business partnerships in which each party performs the obligations set out on the Cover Page, including optional fees, trademark use and feedback.

templates.name: Pilot Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard Pilot Agreement letting a customer evaluate a product for a limited Pilot Period before a full purchase.

templates.name: Professional Services Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard Professional Services Agreement (PSA) for consulting and other services, with Deliverables defined in statements of work (SOWs).

templates.name: Service Level Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper Service Level Agreement (SLA) defining uptime commitments, support response times and service credits for a cloud service.

templates.name: Software License Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard Software License Agreement for licensing installed or on-premises software to a customer.
